detailed_descriptions.en: 🐛 Bugs are everywhere! It's time to clean them up! Build your team or go solo—stop this invasion! 🔥 Burn them with the blowtorch! Use the power of fire to burn the invaders to a crisp! 🦟 Spray them with the pesticide machine! Force the bugs to disappear into the toxic mist! 🌀 Vacuum them up with the vacuum cleaner! Suck them all up in one go and leave behind a pristine area! 🐱 Detect bugs with your trained cat, Sniffers! Sniffers can sense bugs in any area it sniffs! With its warnings, every corner is ready to be cleaned. A fast and reliable helper—always by your side on this mission! 👣 Squish bugs with your hands, stomp them mercilessly with your feet! Sometimes, getting the job done means squishing bugs in one swipe with your hands and stomping them with your feet—end for the bugs, relaxation for you! 🎯 Chaotic missions, absurd humor, fun cleaning! Ready for the craziest cleaning experience, solo or with your team!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🐛 Bugs are everywhere!
It's time to clean them up! Build your team or go solo—stop this invasion!

🔥 Burn them with the blowtorch!
Use the power of fire to burn the invaders to a crisp!

🦟 Spray them with the pesticide machine!
Force the bugs to disappear into the toxic mist!

🌀 Vacuum them up with the vacuum cleaner!
Suck them all up in one go and leave behind a pristine area!

🐱 Detect bugs with your trained cat, Sniffers!
Sniffers can sense bugs in any area it sniffs! With its warnings, every corner is ready to be cleaned. A fast and reliable helper—always by your side on this mission!

👣 Squish bugs with your hands, stomp them mercilessly with your feet!
Sometimes, getting the job done means squishing bugs in one swipe with your hands and stomping them with your feet—end for the bugs, relaxation for you!

🎯 Chaotic missions, absurd humor, fun cleaning!
Ready for the craziest cleaning experience, solo or with your team!
